notes.title: Action! 4.43.0 with critical fixes for Windows 11 24H2 update is now available!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

First of all we are sorry for any problems you might have had with Action! after upgrading to the latest 24H2 Windows 11 version. This update is very big and changes a lot in Windows architecture (that's why there are words it should be called Windows 12). 

Most of the Windows 11 display core has changed and the desktop no longer uses a "swap chain" presentation model. Instead Direct Display is now used and allows direct rendering of desktops with any framerate to the display devices. Also multiplane overlays are now used on all supporting hardware (you can check for MPO3 support in Dxdiag application for you GPU).

Some of you may know what Multiplane overlays are and what headache they can cause (including game flickering/crashing etc.). Since there is no official information on how to disable MPO in the system (there was a magic registry key but it is not working anymore) we are going to provide a small app called MPOOFF that can disable Multiplane Overlays deep in the system. It will be available for download on our Remotly product website remotly.com soon (on the community page).

How Multiplane overlays work? In short these are hardware accelerated graphics/video planes that are composed using special hardware offloading GPU 3D core. In the past this composing was done in DWM (Desktop Window Manager) using 3D shaders, sharing processing power with 3D apps and games.

Below please find all fixes for 24H2 included in version 4.43.0:

- Fixed HUD in desktop mode (fix for Windows 11 24H2 update)
- Fixed automatic HDR detection for games (fix for Windows 11 24H2 update)
- Fixed audio recording from selected application (fix for Windows 11 24H2 update)
- Fixed drawing panel (fix for Windows 11 24H2 update)
- Improved HUD refresh in desktop mode
- Fixed capturing Windows Store games (in Game Mode) when WindowsApps folder is root (C:\) folder

notes.title: Action! 4.38.1 with hotfix for bug in Nvidia drivers is available.
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone,

This update addresses a problem with the newest Nvidia drivers. Video resolutions that are aligned (in height) to 32 pixels were not encoded properly.

Additionally you can also try the beta APK of Action! RCU 2.0 app for Android. The link to the download is available in the changelog. The app is now compatible with Android 13 (API 33+).

After beta tests it will be uploaded to the Google Play Store and later updated with a new app that will show real time preview of the recording/stream on mobile devices, offloading preview rendering from the GPU.

notes.title: Action! 4.21.4 update is ready!
notes.notes:
Hi Everybody,

This version improves OriSound function (capturing audio from selected application or game). 
Automatic switching between audio sources was not always working properly.

We have also improved GPU selection when 2 or more GPUs from the same vendor are present in the system. This is typical for laptops with AMD GPUs or the latest Intel laptops with Iris and Iris MAX (DG1) installed. The default GPU was used for encoding even if the game was running on the high performance one. Now Action! selects the GPU that will give the best performance and the least frame drop.

We have also fixed Action! not starting on Windows 11 build 22449.1000

notes.title: Action! 4.19.0 audio HOTFIX!
notes.notes:
Dear Users,

We have found a critical audio bug in live broadcasting to YouTube (either RTMP/RTMPS or HLS). Please do accept our apologies for this inconvenience. This has happened during Action 5 development and addition of unlimited audio tracks (and since Action 5 shares core with Action 4 thus this problem occurred).

notes.title: Action! 4.19.0 is now available! (Action! 5 status update)
notes.notes:
To improve UI performance we have to rewrite Action 5 rendering engine to work entirely in 3D. This will allow us to support dynamic scaling to any DPI (100%, 125%, 150%... user interface size). This will also allow us to visualize 3D transitions between scenes and add amazing video effects in real-time (like advanced sharpening, color enhancement and many others).

Thanks to your support we are also releasing a new free product soon: "Mirillis AI virtual cam" that will allow to remove webcam background in amazing quality and replace it with images or videos! You will be able to use it in any application (including Action of course) and on any CPU/GPU.

Thank you!

List of changes in Action! 4.19.0:

 - Improved audio recording from selected applications and games
 - Vulkan API support improvements (updated to version 1.2). Fixes issues with some Vulkan titles.
 - Improved recording file naming

notes.title: Action 4 release date announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6003958/32d87bcf98ce2aa7e2d83edeccc694eaa71a972b.png

Today we have fantastic news for you all! 

Action 4 is almost ready and will be released to the public in December. Just like 7 years ago when Action! came to life with top recording performance even on low-end machines, this time we are going to raise the bar even higher!

Our new Zero Frame Drop capturing engine guarantees outstanding recording and streaming performance no matter if the video is HD, 4K or even 8K! It even outperforms hardware capturing cards! 

Below please find a list of new features that will be available in Action 4:

- Zero Frame Drop engine for Direct3D 9/10/11/12, OpenGL and Vulkan. No drops, no lags, ever.
- Real-time HDR10 encoding (on selected hardware configurations)
- Recording audio only from selected applications
- Advanced scene manager for broadcasting (available in spring 2020)
- HEVC encoding on Intel, AMD, and Nvidia
- AVX512 optimizations

Of course, the update will be free for all Steam Action 3 users.

Below is the list of changes in the newest 3.10.2 version:

- Added integration with Mixer
- Fixed Vulkan recording/streaming (No Man's Sky etc.)
- Fixed live user count number on HUD for Twitch
- Fixed support for DLive streaming platform
- Fixed support for AMD RX 5700 and newer GPUs
- OpenGL recording improvements
- Fixed OpenGL upside down recording on AMD GPUs
